name: Battle Master

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: A tactician who spends Superiority Dice on maneuvers that trip, disarm, rally and parry.

feature.name: Combat Superiority
feature.summary: Four d8 Superiority Dice (back on a rest) fuel three maneuvers you learn; save DC 8 + Str or Dex + PB.
feature.text: You learn three maneuvers (more at levels 7, 10 and 15) and can swap one whenever you gain a Fighter level. You have four Superiority Dice, d8s (five at 7, six at 15; d10 at 10, d12 at 18); a maneuver uses one, and you regain all of them on a Short or Long Rest. Maneuver saves use DC 8 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) + Proficiency Bonus.

options.name: Ambush
options.summary: Add a Superiority Die to a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll.

options.name: Bait and Switch
options.summary: Swap places with a willing creature within 5 feet (costs 5 feet of movement); one of you adds the die to AC until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Commander's Strike
options.summary: Give up one attack of your Attack action so an ally can use its Reaction to make an attack, adding the die to its damage.

options.name: Commanding Presence
options.summary: Add a Superiority Die to a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion) check.

options.name: Disarming Attack
options.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; the target makes a Strength save or drops one object it holds.

options.name: Distracting Strike
options.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; the next attack roll by someone else against the target before your next turn has Advantage.

options.name: Evasive Footwork
options.summary: Bonus Action: take the Disengage action and add the die to your AC until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Feinting Attack
options.summary: Bonus Action: feint a creature within 5 feet for Advantage on your next attack against it this turn; on a hit add the die to damage.

options.name: Goading Attack
options.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the end of your next turn.

options.name: Lunging Attack
options.summary: Bonus Action: take the Dash action; if you move 5+ feet straight toward a target and hit it with a melee attack this turn, add the die to damage.

options.name: Maneuvering Attack
options.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; an ally who can see or hear you can use its Reaction to move half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.

options.name: Menacing Attack
options.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

options.name: Parry
options.summary: Reaction when a melee attack roll damages you: reduce the damage by the die plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier.

options.name: Precision Attack
options.summary: When you miss with an attack roll, add the die to the roll, possibly turning it into a hit.

options.name: Pushing Attack
options.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is pushed up to 15 feet away.

options.name: Rally
options.summary: Bonus Action: an ally who can see or hear you gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the die roll plus half your Fighter level (round down).

options.name: Riposte
options.summary: Reaction when a creature misses you with a melee attack: make a melee attack against it, adding the die to damage on a hit.

options.name: Sweeping Attack
options.summary: When you hit with a melee attack, another creature within 5 feet of the target and within your reach takes damage equal to the die roll if your attack roll would hit it.

options.name: Tactical Assessment
options.summary: Add a Superiority Die to an Intelligence (History or Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) check.

options.name: Trip Attack
options.summary: On a hit, add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or falls Prone.

feature.name: Student of War
feature.summary: Proficiency with one Artisan's Tool and one Fighter skill.

feature.name: Know Your Enemy
feature.summary: Bonus Action: learn a creature's Immunities, Resistances and Vulnerabilities.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action, study a creature within 30 feet to learn its damage and condition Immunities, Resistances and Vulnerabilities. Once per Long Rest, or spend a Superiority Die to do it again.

feature.name: Relentless
feature.summary: Once per turn, roll 1d8 for a maneuver instead of spending a Superiority Die.
